summary: First full e2e run of the TryBuzzer clone. Backend: 23 pytest tests (public, auth/roles, onboarding, brand credit/campaign/pause/close-refund, submission full flow incl. platform/domain + duplicate check, budget cap, below-min rejection, withdrawals approve/reject/refund, notifications, real Komerce sandbox QRIS + VA topup + status check). 22/23 pass; one critical money bug found (over-payout after campaign close). Frontend (Playwright): landing (role toggle, calculator slider, FAQ, trending, see-all), /bounty (rows, search, category chips, exclusive tab, Instruksi dialog, unauth submit -> Google login), onboarding with role=null -> creator -> /dashboard, creator submit from /bounty (mismatch error toast, success -> dashboard 'Direview', streak 1), admin approve content -> creator claim -> admin verify (payout Rp 100.000 credited), notification bell unread count + dropdown + mark-read, creator withdraw (balance deducted, min warning/disabled), admin approve withdraw with reference, admin '+ Saldo' brand credit, brand create campaign (insufficient balance toast, success deducts), pause/close refund, topup dialog QRIS (QR rendered) + VA BNI (VA number shown), 'Cek status' and topup history. All UI flows passed. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow.

critical.issue: Money is created out of thin air: closing a campaign refunds (budget - spent) to the brand, but submissions still in direview/menunggu_views/diproses on that campaign can still be approved/claimed/verified afterwards, and verify pays min(payout, budget - spent) again. Reproduced: budget 100.000, claim 5.000 views at 10.000/1K -> brand closes (refund 100.000) -> brand verifies -> creator paid 50.000. Total out 150.000 > budget 100.000. Test: TestSubmissionFlow::test_closed_campaign_no_double_pay

minor.issue: The duplicate check is an exact string match, so the same video can be submitted again with a query string (?is_from_webapp=1), a trailing slash, a different host (www vs m vs no www) or different case. Normalize URLs before the check and before storing them (lowercase the host, strip the query/fragment and trailing slash).

The submission is locked to status 'verifying'. If an exception happens after the lock (e.g. the campaign doc is missing), it stays stuck in 'verifying' forever. Wrap the logic in try/except and revert to 'diproses' on error.
Only deletes the session found in the cookie. A Bearer-token session is not invalidated (minor).
'pending' estimate ignores the remaining campaign budget cap, so it can overstate what will be paid (minor/UX).

The signature is verified as HMAC-SHA256(callback_key, raw body). Confirm this matches the Komerce callback spec; they may send the callback_api_key as-is in the header. If it doesn't match, real callbacks will all fail with 401. Crediting falls back to the manual 'Cek status', so this is not blocking.

issues: The slider track is nearly invisible: dark track on the dark (#0F172A) card. Only the white thumb is visible. Use a light/orange track and range color.
The hero role toggle labels 'Saya Brand' / 'Saya Kreator' wrap onto two lines. Reduce the padding or use whitespace-nowrap.
The selected role card's content is offset vertically compared to the unselected card (slight misalignment of icon/title between the two cards).
The 'Buka halaman pembayaran' link and the status badge sit on the same line with no spacing. Stack them or add a gap.
It shows real approved payouts, so test data ('Test C.') now appears publicly. Expected, but consider cleaning test data before demo.

action_items: CRITICAL: Prevent payouts beyond the campaign budget after close/refund. Option A: on close, auto-reject (or block) pending submissions (direview/menunggu_views/diproses). Option B: make review/claim/verify require campaign status != closed and compute payout only from non-refunded budget. Best: track a 'refunded' amount so verify uses budget - spent - refunded.
Normalize video URLs before the duplicate check and storage.
Revert the 'verifying' lock on exceptions in verify_views.
Make the calculator slider track visible on the dark card.
Minor mobile/spacing tweaks listed in design_issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 774 lines (>700). Split it into routers (auth, campaigns, submissions, payments, admin).
campaign_status: a 'paused' campaign keeps its budget (no refund). That's fine, but the review request says 'pause/close refunds'. Only close refunds, which is the correct design.
Submissions on paused campaigns can still be reviewed/verified and paid. That's acceptable, but it's the same root cause as the close bug when the status is 'closed'.
ADMIN_EMAIL uses os.environ.get with a '' default. Fine, but per guidelines, fail fast.
Pytest runs with xdist by default in this env. The tests share brand balances, so run them with -n 0.
test_credentials: Sessions created in Mongo (test_database): admin test_session_user_tadmin (user_tadmin), creator test_session_user_tcreator, creator2 test_session_user_tcreator2, brand test_session_brand (user_tbrand), brand2 test_session_user_tbrand2, norole test_session_user_tnorole (reset by the test), UI creator test_session_user_tnorole_ui (now role=creator).
seed_data_creation: Created the users/sessions above, plus TEST_-prefixed campaigns (all set to closed afterwards), submissions, withdrawals, and Komerce sandbox topups (pending). Admin credits were applied to user_tbrand and user_tbrand2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_trybuzzer_api.py -n 0. test_closed_campaign_no_double_pay is the regression test for the critical bug. Withdrawal tests need creator balance >= 100000, which the earlier flow tests in the same run provide. UI uses the session_token cookie (secure, SameSite None) on the preview domain. Admin prompts (window.prompt) need page.on('dialog').
rca of the issue: Close-refund double pay: campaign_status refunds max(budget - spent, 0) but does not record the refund or change budget. verify_views later computes amount = min(payout, budget - spent), which is still > 0 because 'spent' was not increased by the refund. Repro: create a 100k campaign -> submit -> approve -> claim 5000 views -> close (brand +100k) -> verify 5000 (creator +50k). Mitigation: on close, set budget = spent (or add a refunded field) atomically, and/or reject review/claim/verify when the campaign is closed. Then pending submissions get a 'ditolak: campaign ditutup' notification.
